marker_reviews.reason: The DO block's execute format only drops UNIQUE (company_code, prod_order_no, prod_line_seq) if that exact constraint still exists under a non-standard name. The static DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS in the same migration already targets the auto-named constraint, so after apply the durable catalog state is simply the absence of any unique constraint on prod_detail involving prod_line_seq. That absence is asserted from pg_constraint by catalog contract coldlion_unit_5b_landing_v2 in this sidecar (no unique constraint on coldlion.prod_detail; the pkey and the rest of the landing shape intact), by live proof .github/live-proofs/3234.sql, and by supabase/tests/coldlion_prepack_prod_detail_landing_contracts.sql. The execute creates, alters and drops no other object and writes no row.
